task_has_assignee.name: task_has_assignee
task_has_assignee.value: "task"."assignee_role" is not null or "task"."assignee_staff_user_id" is not null

task_closed_with_decision.name: task_closed_with_decision
task_closed_with_decision.value: "task"."status" <> 'closed' or ("task"."decision" is not null and "task"."closed_at" is not null)

patient_link_subject_fits.name: patient_link_subject_fits
patient_link_subject_fits.value:
("patient_link"."purpose" <> 'health_form' or "patient_link"."appointment_id" is not null)
        and ("patient_link"."purpose" not in ('questionnaire', 'my_plan', 'follow_up') or "patient_link"."episode_id" is not null)

kiosk_device_stopped.name: kiosk_device_stopped
kiosk_device_stopped.value:
("kiosk_device"."stopped_at" is null) = ("kiosk_device"."stopped_by" is null)
        and ("kiosk_device"."stopped_at" is null or "kiosk_device"."current_link_id" is null)

discount_preset_amount.name: discount_preset_amount
discount_preset_amount.value:
("discount_preset"."kind" = 'percent' and "discount_preset"."percent" between 1 and 100 and "discount_preset"."amount_paise" is null)
        or ("discount_preset"."kind" = 'flat' and "discount_preset"."amount_paise" > 0 and "discount_preset"."percent" is null)

staff_leave_decided.name: staff_leave_decided
staff_leave_decided.value:
("staff_leave"."status" <> 'requested' or "staff_leave"."decided_by" is null)
        and ("staff_leave"."status" not in ('approved', 'declined') or "staff_leave"."decided_by" is not null)
        and ("staff_leave"."decided_by" is null) = ("staff_leave"."decided_at" is null)

kb_condition_listing_age.name: kb_condition_listing_age
kb_condition_listing_age.value: "kb_condition_listing"."age_min" is null or "kb_condition_listing"."age_max" is null or "kb_condition_listing"."age_min" <= "kb_condition_listing"."age_max"

kb_red_flag_presentation_kind.name: kb_red_flag_presentation_kind
kb_red_flag_presentation_kind.value: "kb_red_flag_presentation"."kind" = 'screening_note' or ("kb_red_flag_presentation"."features" is not null and "kb_red_flag_presentation"."action" is not null)

kb_version_approved.name: kb_version_approved
kb_version_approved.value: ("kb_version"."status" = 'approved') = ("kb_version"."approved_by" is not null and "kb_version"."approved_at" is not null)

episode_discharged_closed.name: episode_discharged_closed
episode_discharged_closed.value: ("episode"."status" = 'discharged') = ("episode"."closed_at" is not null and "episode"."discharge_reason" is not null)

episode_discharge_report.name: episode_discharge_report
episode_discharge_report.value: "episode"."status" = 'discharged' or ("episode"."discharge_goals" is null and "episode"."discharge_ongoing_needs" is null and "episode"."discharge_recommendations" is null)

episode_discharge_plans.name: episode_discharge_plans
episode_discharge_plans.value: "episode"."status" = 'discharged' or ("episode"."discharge_return_plan" is null and "episode"."discharge_flare_plan" is null)

appointment_change.name: appointment_change
appointment_change.value: ("appointment"."status" in ('cancelled', 'rescheduled')) = ("appointment"."change_reason" is not null and "appointment"."changed_at" is not null and "appointment"."changed_by" is not null) and ("appointment"."change_reason" is null) = ("appointment"."changed_at" is null) and ("appointment"."change_reason" is null) = ("appointment"."changed_by" is null)

appointment_arrived.name: appointment_arrived
appointment_arrived.value: ("appointment"."status" <> 'checked_in' or "appointment"."arrived_at" is not null) and ("appointment"."arrived_at" is null) = ("appointment"."checked_in_by" is null)

appointment_no_show.name: appointment_no_show
appointment_no_show.value: ("appointment"."status" = 'no_show') = ("appointment"."no_show_at" is not null) and ("appointment"."no_show_at" is null) = ("appointment"."no_show_by" is null)

appointment_started.name: appointment_started
appointment_started.value: ("appointment"."status" <> 'in_progress' or "appointment"."started_at" is not null) and ("appointment"."started_at" is null) = ("appointment"."started_by" is null)

appointment_machine_unit.name: appointment_machine_unit
appointment_machine_unit.value: ("appointment"."machine" is null) = ("appointment"."machine_unit" is null) and ("appointment"."machine_unit" is null or "appointment"."machine_unit" >= 1)

slot_hold_machine_unit.name: slot_hold_machine_unit
slot_hold_machine_unit.value: ("slot_hold"."machine" is null) = ("slot_hold"."machine_unit" is null) and ("slot_hold"."machine_unit" is null or "slot_hold"."machine_unit" >= 1)

consent_record_signature.name: consent_record_signature
consent_record_signature.value:
case when "consent_record"."accepted" then
        ("consent_record"."signature_kind" = 'drawn' and "consent_record"."signature_file" is not null and "consent_record"."typed_name" is null)
        or ("consent_record"."signature_kind" = 'typed' and "consent_record"."typed_name" is not null and "consent_record"."signature_file" is null)
      else "consent_record"."signature_kind" is null and "consent_record"."signature_file" is null and "consent_record"."typed_name" is null end

consultation_signed.name: consultation_signed
consultation_signed.value: ("consultation"."status" = 'signed') = ("consultation"."signed_at" is not null) and ("consultation"."signed_at" is null) = ("consultation"."signed_by" is null)

phase_move_shape.name: phase_move_shape
phase_move_shape.value:
"phase_move"."from_phase" >= 0 and "phase_move"."to_phase" >= 0 and (
        ("phase_move"."kind" = 'progress' and "phase_move"."to_phase" = "phase_move"."from_phase" + 1
          and "phase_move"."reason" is null)
        or ("phase_move"."kind" = 'override' and "phase_move"."to_phase" <> "phase_move"."from_phase"
          and length(trim("phase_move"."reason")) between 1 and 1000))

plan_of_care_frequency.name: plan_of_care_frequency
plan_of_care_frequency.value: ("plan_of_care"."sessions_per_week" is null or "plan_of_care"."sessions_per_week" between 1 and 7) and ("plan_of_care"."weeks" is null or "plan_of_care"."weeks" between 1 and 52)

readiness_mark_shape.name: readiness_mark_shape
readiness_mark_shape.value:
("readiness_mark"."kind" = 'check' and "readiness_mark"."result" is not null and "readiness_mark"."reason" is null)
        or ("readiness_mark"."kind" = 'override' and "readiness_mark"."result" is null
          and length(trim("readiness_mark"."reason")) between 1 and 1000)

reassessment_signed.name: reassessment_signed
reassessment_signed.value: ("reassessment"."decision" is null) = ("reassessment"."signed_by" is null) and ("reassessment"."signed_by" is null) = ("reassessment"."signed_at" is null)

reassessment_decision.name: reassessment_decision
reassessment_decision.value: "reassessment"."decision" is null or length(trim("reassessment"."decision")) between 1 and 2000

plan_choice_details.name: plan_choice_details
plan_choice_details.value:
case "plan_choice"."choice"
        when 'package' then "plan_choice"."package_type_id" is not null and "plan_choice"."session_price_item_id" is not null
        when 'per_session' then "plan_choice"."package_type_id" is null and "plan_choice"."session_price_item_id" is not null
        else "plan_choice"."package_type_id" is null and "plan_choice"."session_price_item_id" is null
      end

bill_source.name: bill_source
bill_source.value:
case "bill"."kind"
        when 'consultation' then "bill"."appointment_id" is not null and "bill"."plan_choice_id" is null
        else "bill"."plan_choice_id" is not null and "bill"."appointment_id" is null
      end

bill_cancelled.name: bill_cancelled
bill_cancelled.value: ("bill"."status" = 'cancelled') = ("bill"."cancelled_at" is not null and "bill"."cancel_reason" is not null)

bill_line_discount.name: bill_line_discount
bill_line_discount.value:
case
        when "bill_line"."discount_kind" is null then "bill_line"."discount_paise" = 0
          and "bill_line"."discount_preset_id" is null and "bill_line"."discount_name" is null
          and "bill_line"."discount_percent" is null and "bill_line"."discount_reason" is null
          and "bill_line"."discounted_by" is null and "bill_line"."discounted_at" is null
        else "bill_line"."discount_paise" >= 1 and "bill_line"."discount_paise" < "bill_line"."amount_paise"
          and "bill_line"."discounted_by" is not null and "bill_line"."discounted_at" is not null
          and length(trim("bill_line"."discount_name")) between 1 and 60
          and ("bill_line"."discount_preset_id" is not null
            or length(trim("bill_line"."discount_reason")) between 1 and 300)
          and case "bill_line"."discount_kind"
            when 'percent' then "bill_line"."discount_percent" between 1 and 100
              and "bill_line"."discount_paise" = ("bill_line"."amount_paise"::bigint * "bill_line"."discount_percent" + 50) / 100
            else "bill_line"."discount_percent" is null
          end
      end

payment_undone.name: payment_undone
payment_undone.value: ("payment"."undone_at" is null) = ("payment"."undone_by" is null) and ("payment"."undone_at" is null) = ("payment"."undo_reason" is null)

package_source.name: package_source
package_source.value: ("package"."opening_entry_id" is null) = ("package"."bill_id" is not null and "package"."payment_id" is not null and "package"."package_type_id" is not null)

session_signed.name: session_signed
session_signed.value: ("session"."status" = 'signed') = ("session"."signed_at" is not null) and ("session"."signed_at" is null) = ("session"."signed_by" is null)

session_signed_pain.name: session_signed_pain
session_signed_pain.value: "session"."status" = 'draft' or ("session"."pain_rest" is not null and "session"."pain_activity" is not null and "session"."pain_after" is not null)

session_pain_range.name: session_pain_range
session_pain_range.value: "session"."pain_rest" between 0 and 10 and "session"."pain_activity" between 0 and 10 and "session"."pain_after" between 0 and 10

session_adverse_event.name: session_adverse_event
session_adverse_event.value: "session"."adverse_event" is null or length(trim("session"."adverse_event")) between 1 and 2000

feedback_comment.name: feedback_comment
feedback_comment.value: "feedback"."comment" is null or length("feedback"."comment") between 1 and 1000

feedback_discharge.name: feedback_discharge
feedback_discharge.value: "feedback"."survey_key" <> 'discharge' or ("feedback"."score" is not null and "feedback"."appointment_id" is null and "feedback"."consultation_id" is null)

feedback_post_consultation.name: feedback_post_consultation
feedback_post_consultation.value: "feedback"."survey_key" <> 'post_consultation' or ("feedback"."appointment_id" is not null and "feedback"."consultation_id" is not null and "feedback"."physio_id" is not null)

feedback_follow_up.name: feedback_follow_up
feedback_follow_up.value:
"feedback"."survey_key" <> 'follow_up' or ("feedback"."appointment_id" is null
        and "feedback"."consultation_id" is null and "feedback"."score" is null and "feedback"."comment" is null
        and "feedback"."answers" ->> 'since_discharge' in ('doing_well', 'some_pain', 'injured_again')
        and "feedback"."answers" ->> 'follow_up' ~ '^[0-9]+_(week|month)$'
        and "feedback"."answers" - 'since_discharge' - 'follow_up' = '{}'::jsonb)

feedback_first_treatment.name: feedback_first_treatment
feedback_first_treatment.value:
"feedback"."survey_key" <> 'first_treatment' or ("feedback"."appointment_id" is not null
        and "feedback"."consultation_id" is null and "feedback"."physio_id" is not null
        and "feedback"."score" is null and "feedback"."comment" is null
        and "feedback"."answers" ->> 'since_first_treatment' in ('better', 'same', 'still_sore')
        and "feedback"."answers" - 'since_first_treatment' = '{}'::jsonb)

ai_preparation_sheet_recheck.name: ai_preparation_sheet_recheck
ai_preparation_sheet_recheck.value:
("ai_preparation_sheet"."recheck_status" is null) = ("ai_preparation_sheet"."recheck_findings" is null)
        and ("ai_preparation_sheet"."recheck_status" is null) = ("ai_preparation_sheet"."recheck_by" is null)
        and ("ai_preparation_sheet"."recheck_status" is null) = ("ai_preparation_sheet"."recheck_claimed_at" is null)
        and ("ai_preparation_sheet"."recheck_status" is null or ("ai_preparation_sheet"."recheck_status" = 'pending') = ("ai_preparation_sheet"."recheck_ready_at" is null))
        and ("ai_preparation_sheet"."recheck_status" is null or ("ai_preparation_sheet"."recheck_status" = 'unavailable') = ("ai_preparation_sheet"."recheck_reason" is not null))
        and ("ai_preparation_sheet"."recheck_reason" is null or "ai_preparation_sheet"."recheck_reason" in ('invalid_output', 'failed', 'timed_out', 'capped', 'blocked', 'not_configured', 'no_region', 'no_form', 'no_valid_suggestions'))

ai_preparation_sheet_reason.name: ai_preparation_sheet_reason
ai_preparation_sheet_reason.value:
("ai_preparation_sheet"."status" = 'unavailable') = ("ai_preparation_sheet"."unavailable_reason" is not null)
        and ("ai_preparation_sheet"."unavailable_reason" is null or "ai_preparation_sheet"."unavailable_reason" in ('invalid_output', 'failed', 'timed_out', 'capped', 'blocked', 'not_configured', 'no_region', 'no_form', 'no_valid_suggestions'))

ai_run_blind_test.name: ai_run_blind_test
ai_run_blind_test.value: "ai_run"."blind_test_run" is null or ("ai_run"."episode_id" is null and "ai_run"."kind" = 'rank_diagnoses')

ai_run_clinical_version.name: ai_run_clinical_version
ai_run_clinical_version.value: "ai_run"."kind" not in ('rank_diagnoses', 'recheck_with_findings') or "ai_run"."kb_version_id" is not null

ai_suggestion_disposed.name: ai_suggestion_disposed
ai_suggestion_disposed.value:
("ai_suggestion"."disposition" is null) = ("ai_suggestion"."disposed_by" is null)
        and ("ai_suggestion"."disposition" is null) = ("ai_suggestion"."disposed_at" is null)
